sloka: तद् बलम् हत भूयिष्ठम् विमनाः प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसः ।आससाद खरो रामम् नमुचिर् वासवम् यथा ॥३-२८-३॥
transliteration: tad balam hata bhūyiṣṭham vimanāḥ prekṣya rākṣasaḥ ।āsasāda kharo rāmam namucir vāsavam yathā ॥3-28-3॥

translations.english: Khara, the mighty demon, saw his large, irrepressible army killed. He saw Trisira and Dusana slain singlehanded by Rama. Nervous, he advanced towards Rama wage war just as Namuchi approached Indra.
translations.hindi: में हथियार छू कर, आपके सामने सत्य प्रतिज्ञा करता हूँ कि, में इस राम को, जो समस्त राक्षसों के मारने योग्य हे, अवश्य मारूंगा
